notes: Fix and an option. The pasted “Click Me” can now carry the font size too (a paste that says nothing about it gets the sheet's 10pt, even in a 12pt row) - put your row's size in Settings, or leave it empty to say nothing. And a second way out of the whole argument: 'Or paste it as a formula' copies =HYPERLINK(...) instead of formatted text, so the cell keeps its own size, font, colour and alignment. A plain box then gets the formula text instead of the URL, so it is off by default.
